title: 第一卷 第79章 大不了我等亲手掀翻这该死的天下第一卷 第78章 救人可以但不要陷入两难之中
lines: 我靠！
这位少主实在太强，带着众人闯出这般风波，竟还能从容脱身、全身而退！
众人的目光看着陈渊，带着崇拜和激动。
陈渊的目光扫过他们神色淡然。
随即，他又看向张山一众，只见他们此刻仅剩五六人还活着。
“哈哈，今日一战着实痛快！不知道友高姓大名？”
唐虎最先回过神，朗声大笑开口问道。
“没错，道友救命之恩，我等没齿难忘，无以为报！”
张山当即抱拳躬身，神色无比郑重，“若是道友不嫌弃，我等愿誓死追随，以自身这条贱民残躯，报答今日救命之恩！”
这话落下，唐虎亦是重重点头，认真的看着陈渊。
若不是陈渊的仗义出手，他们今晚就死在春梦楼了。
“是你？”
就在这时，厉守仁骤然抬手指向陈昭宁，满脸惊色，“你竟是陈家大小姐，陈昭宁！”
此刻陈昭宁发髻散乱，青丝如瀑垂落肩头，将原本绝美的容颜全然展露出来。
纵使脸上沾染斑驳血污，厉守仁依旧一眼便认出了，这位英气飒爽的女子。
毕竟身为四大人族家族之一，他曾经见过对方，也与对方有过点头之交。
这时，陈渊开口了，神色始终淡然，“记住你们今日所言，你们的贱命，我便收下了。”
他目光掠过厉守仁，又落在张山、唐虎，以及被一同救下的牛银花、牛爱花二人身上。
“好好撑过今夜，事后自行前往陈家寻我便可。”
话音落罢，陈渊领着一众陈家子弟，身形掠起，化作数道残影疾驰远去，顷刻间便消融在沉沉夜幕之中。
唐虎咽了咽口水，怔怔看向身旁的张山，“难道他就是陈家少主陈渊？
就是白天斩杀卢志远的那位狠人？”
“难怪行事这般杀伐狠绝！”
“他也太过胆大妄为！白天刚闹出那般惊天动静，夜里竟还敢铤而走险，做出这等大事？”
张山眸中精芒乍现，沉声道：“或许，他本就是特意为我们三人而来。”
说着，他转头看向唐虎与厉守仁，眼神愈发坚定，
“我们必须活下去，既要让他看清我们的价值！
也要让他知晓，今夜出手救下我们，绝非错事！”
话音落下，他转身率先离去。
人一旦有了执念与目标，便会生出极强的求生之心。
只要一心求存，活下去的希望，自然极大！
春梦楼。
content_en:
Holy shit!
This young master is so powerful that he managed to lead everyone through such a turmoil and yet he was able to escape calmly and escape unscathed!
Everyone looked at Chen Yuan with admiration and excitement.
Chen Yuan glanced at them with indifferent expressions.
Immediately, he looked at Zhang Shan's group and saw that only five or six of them were still alive.
"Haha, today's battle was really fun! Don't you know the name of Tougao?"
Tang Hu was the first to come to his senses, laughed loudly and asked.
"That's right, fellow Taoist's life-saving grace will be unforgettable and cannot be repaid by me!"
Zhang Shan immediately clasped his fists and bowed, with an extremely solemn expression, "If fellow Taoist disciples don't dislike you, we are willing to follow him to the death and use our untouchable body to repay the grace of saving my life today!"
After saying this, Tang Hu nodded heavily and looked at Chen Yuan seriously.
If it weren't for Chen Yuan's generous action, they would have died in Chunmeng Tower tonight.
"Is it you?"
At this moment, Li Shouren suddenly raised his hand and pointed at Chen Zhaoning, with a look of shock on his face, "You are actually the eldest lady of the Chen family, Chen Zhaoning!"
At this moment, Chen Zhaoning's bun was messy, and her black hair fell down like a waterfall on her shoulders, fully revealing her original beautiful face.
Even though his face was stained with blood, Li Shouren still recognized this heroic woman at a glance.
After all, as one of the four major human families, he had met each other before and had some acquaintances with them.
"Okay."
At this time, Chen Yuan spoke, his expression always calm, "Remember what you said today, I will accept your despicable life."
His eyes passed over Li Shouren, and then fell on Zhang Shan, Tang Hu, and Niu Yinhua and Niu Aihua who were rescued together.
"Get through tonight well and then go to the Chen family to find me afterwards."
As soon as he finished speaking, Chen Yuan led a group of Chen family disciples, and their figures flew away, turning into several afterimages and galloping away, instantly disappearing into the dark night.
"He..."
Tang Hu swallowed his saliva and looked at Zhang Shan beside him blankly, "Could he be Chen Yuan, the young master of the Chen family?
Is he the ruthless man who killed Lu Zhiyuan during the day? "
"No wonder he acts so cruelly and ruthlessly!"
"He is too bold and arrogant! He just made such a shocking noise during the day, and yet he dares to take risks and do such a big thing at night?"
A bright light suddenly appeared in Zhang Shan's eyes, and he said in a deep voice: "Perhaps, he came here specifically for the three of us."
As he spoke, he turned to look at Tang Hu and Li Shouren, his eyes becoming firmer.
"We must survive, not only to let him see our value!
We also want him to know that it is absolutely not a wrong thing to save us tonight! "
"Let's go!"
After the words fell, he turned around and left first.
Once people have obsessions and goals, they will develop a strong desire to survive.
As long as you focus on survival, your chances of survival will be great!
…
Chunmeng Tower.
